content.title: The NCES Fast Facts Tool provides quick answers to many education questions (National Center for Education Statistics)
content.text: ACT scores Question: What are the average scores for students taking the ACT? Response: The ACT (formerly the American College Testing Program) assessment program measures educational development and readiness to pursue college-level coursework in English, mathematics, natural science, and social studies. Student performance on the tests does not reflect innate ability and is influenced by a student's educational preparedness. In 1995, some 38 percent of all high school graduates took the ACT.1 In 2023, some 37 percent of high school graduates were projected to take the ACT. The minimum score on the ACT is 1 and maximum score is 36.
